Priya (Finance): Postmortem follow-up: we need owners for backfill, invoice fixes, and alerting. Brief replies please.

Ashwin (Eng-ML): I can do the backfill and compute corrected token counts. Need raw logs + tokenizer map. ETA: dry-run today, final CSV by tomorrow EOD.

Maya (Billing): I will own invoice corrections and customer credits. Need Ashwin's CSV by Tue 17:00 PT to meet billing cycle.

Sam (Eng-SRE): I'll own alerts + runbook. Adding detection for ingestion lag > 10m and a pre-apply sanity check step for deltas. Can create PR by tomorrow.

Leo (Platform): Quick mitigation: pin metering-api min replicas=3 and add token-bucket backpressure. Will open PR this afternoon. Observed autoscaler flapping at 2025-11-12T02:14Z.

LedgerBot: Ticket FI-4419 created: "Metering backfill + invoice corrections" assigned to Maya (Billing).

Priya (Finance): Draft customer message: apology + credit + link to appendix. I'll draft and loop Legal. Delivery Tue 09:00 PT.

Ashwin (Eng-ML): Logs exported: s3://redwood-metering/exports/1799905555-logs.tar.gz. Running dry-run now:

```
metering-backfill --from 2025-11-10 --to 2025-11-12 --dry-run --out deltas.csv
```

Ashwin (Eng-ML): Dry-run done, uploaded s3://redwood-metering/deltas/1799905555-deltas.csv. A couple of accounts show >5% delta, flagging for review.

Sam (Eng-SRE): I'll schedule the maintenance window Wed 00:30-01:30 UTC and be on-call for the apply. Will add dashboard panel for ingestion lag by region.

Maya (Billing): Preliminary credit estimate ~ $8.5k across two customers. Holding until Ashwin confirms.

Priya (Finance): Action list for tracker (I'll update postmortem): Ashwin = backfill + final counts (target Wed EOD), Sam = runbook + alerts (PR by Tue), Leo = infra PR (Mon), Maya = invoices + comms (Tue COB). I'll ping execs after final numbers.

LedgerBot: Reminder set: FI-4419 check-in in 48h.

Maya (Billing): Thanks all. Ping if you need invoice templates or billing-console access.
